_licenseInfo.text: A 14-day trial starts on the first run. After that the adapter needs a licence key bound to this computer.

licenseKey.label: License Key
licenseKey.help: Enter your license key here. Contact gokturk413 for a valid license key.

_licenseWarning.text: ⚠️ Important: a licence key is bound to the Hardware ID of one computer, VM or container. Each of them needs its own licence; copying or moving a licensed VM is not allowed.

hardwareId.label: Hardware ID
hardwareId.help: Copy the whole line (copy button) and send it to gokturk413. It usually holds two IDs: the mainboard and the operating-system installation.

_hardwareIdInfo.text: ℹ️ Why two IDs: if only one of them changes (a new mainboard, or a reinstalled operating system), the key keeps working for 14 days of grace, so there is time to request a new key. If both change, it is another computer and the key does not work.

_instructions.text:
1. Start the adapter: a 14-day trial starts automatically
2. Copy the whole Hardware ID line above
3. Send it to gokturk413 to get a licence key
4. Enter the licence key here and save (the adapter restarts)

💡 When the trial ends without a key, the runtime stops. A project made during the trial keeps working once the key is entered.
💡 For a new computer, send its Hardware ID to get a key for it.

_grafanaInfo.text: If Grafana is not installed or nginx is not configured, keep this disabled. The adapter will not throw any errors.

grafanaUrl.label: Grafana Internal URL
grafanaUrl.help: Internal URL of Grafana (not nginx proxy URL)

grafanaLangSyncEnabled.label: Language Sync (webui → Grafana)
grafanaLangSyncEnabled.help: When user changes language in webui, also update Grafana UI language

_langSyncInfo.text:
ℹ️ Requires Grafana Auth Proxy (X-WEBAUTH-USER) to be enabled in grafana.ini.
[auth.proxy]
enabled = true
header_name = X-WEBAUTH-USER
auto_sign_up = true

grafanaSsoEnabled.label: SSO via nginx auth_request
grafanaSsoEnabled.help: nginx auth_request forwards ioBroker session to Grafana — users auto-login to Grafana iframe
